difficulty_reason: Prove a Zariski sheaf G with a subfunctor F that is representable, embedded by open immersions, and transversal (for every field-valued g there is g' with g'g in F) is representable by a group scheme: apply schemes-lemma-glue-functors with index set I = G(k); for g' in I take F_i = {g in G(T) : g'g in F(T)}, isomorphic to F by multiplication with g'; each F_i -> G is isomorphic to F -> G hence representable by open immersions; the family covers G by the transversality condition (2)(c).
